name: daily_stock_analysis
description: LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
one_liner: A free, self-run tool that reads stock prices and news every day, has an AI summarize what's happening, and pushes you a daily briefing dashboard — like a personal junior analyst you don't pay a salary.
buyer: A retail investor or small trading club in Asia who wants a daily market briefing without paying for a Bloomberg Terminal or analyst subscription.
business_use_cases: An individual trader runs it on a free GitHub Actions schedule and gets a daily push notification summarizing their watchlist.
A small investment club or Discord/WeChat trading community self-hosts it and shares the daily dashboard as a group perk.
A finance content creator uses its output as the raw material for a daily newsletter or video, saving hours of manual research.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, no-setup version with push notifications as a cheap monthly subscription for people who don't want to run GitHub Actions themselves
White-label the dashboard for small financial content creators or trading communities who want a branded version

steal_this: Turn it into a $5/month 'daily stock briefing to your phone' bot this weekend — but be upfront that it's a research/news summarizer, not a signal service, to stay on the right side of financial-advice regulations.
